chunks: Ahmad ibn Muhammad from al-Husayn from Fadalah from Aban from al-Fadl, Abu al-Abbas, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him)
Regarding the saying of Allah, Exalted and Mighty: 'And complete the Hajj and Umrah for Allah,' he said: 'They are two obligatory duties.'
ai.seo_question: What is the ruling on Hajj and Umrah according to this hadith?
ai.summary: Recorded in Shaykh al-Tusi’s *Tahdhib al-Ahkam*, this narration from Imam al-Sadiq (AS) offers a definitive jurisprudential ruling on the imperative nature of Hajj and Umrah. By interpreting the command 'complete' as establishing obligation, the Imam clarifies that these are not merely recommended acts but mandatory pillars of worship, a view central to Shia fiqh regarding the validity of the pilgrimage.
